room_rent.note: Policy covers room rent, boarding expenses up to Sum Insured with no stated sub-limit on room category

icu.note: ICU charges covered under hospitalisation Sum Insured with no stated separate sub-limit

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in the policy wording

sub_limits.note: Organ donor, air ambulance, OPD, physiotherapy, maternity, recovery benefit each have separate specified limits per plan; main hospitalisation SI has no disease-wise sub-limits

deductible.note: No aggregate or per-claim deductible stated in the base policy

initial_waiting.note: 30-day waiting period for illnesses from first policy commencement; accidents exempt

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing disease waiting period is 24 months of continuous coverage from first policy inception

specific_disease_waiting.note: 27 listed conditions (cataracts, hernia, fistula, stones, etc.) have 12-month waiting period; joint replacement, DNS, congenital internal diseases, Parkinson's, laser eye correction have 24-month wait

maternity.note: Inbuilt cover; 24-month waiting period; limited to 2 deliveries/terminations lifetime; separate maternity SI per plan (₹25k–₹1L); includes new born baby cover up to 90 days

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% increase per claim-free year on hospitalisation SI; max 50% over 5 years; reduced by 10% on a claim year but base SI preserved; no transfer from other insurers

restoration.note: 100% of hospitalisation SI reinstated once per policy period after full exhaustion; only for subsequent claims not arising from same illness/disease for which prior claim was made; not carried forward if unused

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days before admission for same condition

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 90 days after discharge for same condition

day_care.note: Indicative list of 130 procedures provided; any procedure requiring <24 hrs due to technology also covered

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered when patient cannot be moved to hospital or no room available

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient hospitalisation covered up to hospitalisation SI; must be in government AYUSH hospital; treatment must require inpatient admission

organ_donor.note: Lump sum benefit for harvesting of donated organ; ₹5k–₹1L depending on plan

ambulance.display: Up to SI (road); air ambulance separate limit
ambulance.note: Road ambulance reimbursed within hospitalisation SI (no separate cap stated); air ambulance has separate SI per plan (₹50k–₹5L)

modern_treatments.note: 11 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, stem cell for haematological, etc.) covered up to base Sum Insured

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable items listed in Annexure II are explicitly excluded; no consumables rider available

global_cover.note: All medical expense covers limited to treatment within India; PA and CI covers worldwide but payment in India only

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except proven fraud and permanent exclusions

grace_period.note: 30 days for quarterly/half-yearly/annual premium; 15 days for monthly premium mode

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration

portability.note: IRDAI portability norms followed; apply at least 30 days before renewal

notable_exclusions.display: No overseas treatment, ectopic pregnancy under maternity (covered under hospitalisation), IVF/ART, external congenital anomalies, refractive error <7.5D, non-medical items (Annexure II)

optional_riders.display: Ancillary Expenses (daily cash + ICU allowance), Critical Illness (15 CIs, lump sum), Personal Accident (death/PTD/PPD/TTD)
